const int MAXN = 1000007;

int countCycle[MAXN];

long long computeCyclePower(int len) {
    long long base = ((long long)len * countCycle[len]) % MOD;
    base = (base + 1) % MOD;
    long long result = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < countCycle[len]; ++i) {
        result = (result * base) % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

    cin >> P >> K;
